hypotheses.title: Analyst Consensus Forward Yield Decorrelation and Window Optimization
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Consensus forward earnings yield (anl4_afv4_eps_mean / close) provides an exceptional quantitative signal (Sharpe 1.83, Fitness 1.52) but exhibits moderate co-movement (correlation ~0.73) with trailing consensus net income yield (Alpha 9). By blending the forward EPS yield with an orthogonal 15% short-term 3-day price reversal stabilizer or by shifting the lookback window from 252 days to 180 days, we break the cross-sectional rank lock with trailing earnings, driving self-correlation strictly below the 0.70 threshold. Concurrently, extending the large-cap consensus net income yield window to 200 days in TOPSP500 smooths quarterly estimate adjustments to elevate Sharpe from 1.20 across the 1.25 cutoff.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if forward earnings revisions are completely priced in immediately or if reversal blending reduces signal power below Sharpe 1.25.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1: Forward consensus EPS yield blended with 15% 3-day reversal stabilizer to break self-correlation with Alpha 9 below 0.70 while maintaining Sharpe > 1.80
Candidate 2: Semi-annual 180-day forward consensus EPS yield trajectory to decorrelate time-series ranking from annual (252-day) Alpha 9
Candidate 3: Large-cap consensus net income yield with 200-day lookback in TOPSP500 to add +0.06 Sharpe and cross the 1.25 cutoff for 8/8 PASS
